main_text.p: ditamento aëris est orta, & etiam- num conservatur. His abundè ma- teriam interioris radicis omnibus ante oculos collocat.

Hîc igitur tanquam ad metam Vniversalis universalissimi & no- bis subsistendum est in regno Mi- nerali, post recensionem Univer- salium, & particularium Tinctu- rarū ferè omniū, de quibus aliqua notitiæ aura ad nos pervenit.

Unum tantum addere visum est propter eos, qui extra Univer- sale universalissimum nihil pror- sus putant esse verum vel profi- cuum, eoq; negant particularia ul- la extra illud esse quærenda: quin omnia dicta Philosophorum ob- tortis crinibus ad Universale dun- taxat trahunt. Quibus quidem fa- cilè concesserim habitâ Univer- sali
Note: the catchword "sali" is printed at the lower right, following the last full line; it is included above as the catchword, and the text ends with the last full line.

page.notes: The page is a text page with a decorative woodcut border on all four sides; no marginal notes printed inside the text block. Underlining appears under "Quibus" and "cilè concesserim habitâ" as printed. The right edge shows part of the facing page (show-through and adjacent page), not transcribed. The top line "ditamento" begins a fragment carried over from the previous page. Possible doubtful reading: "Tinctu- rarū" and "dicta" (rendered as printed "dicta").
